articles.summary: Session to be Livestreamed on the Bitcoin Magazine YouTube Channel Twenty One Capital, Inc. (“Twenty One” or “XXI”) (NYSE: XXI) today announced that Chief Executive Officer Raphael Zagury will speak at the Bitcoin Treasuries Conference 2026, taking place September 28, 2026 at SECOND in New York City. Bitcoin Treasuries Conference 2026 Details Date: September 28, 2026 Venue: SECOND, NYC, 849 6th Avenue, New York, NY, 10001 Speaker: Raphael Zagury, Chief Executive Officer, Twenty One Capital Website: https://bitcointreasuries.net/conference How to Watch The session will be livestreamed on YouTube, available at youtube.com/@timkotzman8925/streams . Additional conference information is available at bitcointreasuries.net . Investors and members of the media interested in scheduling a meeting with Twenty One management during the conference should contact xxi@kcsa.com . About Twenty One Twenty One is a Bitcoin-focused operating company. Designed to pair one of the largest Bitcoin treasuries
articles.title: Twenty One Capital CEO Raphael Zagury to Speak at Bitcoin Treasuries Conference 2026 in New York City
